what: TMS and Peripheral Motor Neurophysiology Analysis
title: TMS and Peripheral Motor Neurophysiology Analysis
text: TMS peripheral motor-neurophysiology analysis Physio ecosystem. package provides TMS pulse metadata, MEP amplitude latency, Boltzmann recruitment curves, H-reflex recruitment Hmax/Mmax summaries, F-wave persistence latency statistics, paired-pulse SICI/ICF, cortical silent-period timing, sample-exact TMS pulse removal, source-informed SSP-SIR SOUND cleaning, canonical TMS-evoked-potential summaries, PREP2 prognosis. TMS-EEG cleaning keeps original assay, records every altered sample fixed cleaning matrix, requires exact lead-field/channel identity. TEP component labels measurement windows, proof cortical source identity; auditory somatosensory confounds can remain.
